note: Fergus County Event Center camping at the fairgrounds (153 Fairgrounds Road) on the south edge of Lewistown, off US 191, with grassy RV and tent sites; sites are close-set and not perfectly level. Stalls and pens available for animals. --Claude
summary: County page: confirmed $55/night (already recorded from Campspot), full hookups (water/sewer). Changed season year_round -> March-October (closed Nov 2026-Feb 2027, and during fair week); site count 40 -> 41; booking platform campspot -> phone/email (reservations required; the Campspot button is not taking bookings). Not stated: amperage (50-amp from Campspot, left), showers/dump (derived, left). Note: 'space is tight around the fair' replaced, since camping is not available fair week.
flags: Price gate: $55/night ('Camping-All'), over US$50, no gateway within 40 km (Yellowstone NP 233 km). Local (county fairground) entry; a human decides whether the gate applies.
Fairground check: camping is open March-October outside fair week, by the night, so it is not events-only.
